---
title: "Candidate replacement ledger"
---

The current cohort contains 565 contracts from 565 distinct event families: 200 Sports, 200 Politics and 165 Economics.

## Latest completed round

[Download the completed candidate ledger (CSV)](downloads/current/candidate-ledger-completed-20260916.csv).

This file covers the completed September 16 event-family replacement round, including 69 accepted replacements and the recorded skips. Each row is an attempt to fill a slot; a candidate can appear more than once. The decision column records final acceptance after validation.

## Replacement rule {#replacement-rule}

1. Stay within the same topic and try the original sampling month first, following the saved random reserve ordering.
2. If no eligible candidates remain in that month, try the nearest available month within September 2025-August 2026. If two months are equally close, try the earlier month first.
3. Preserve the saved random rank within each month. Record attempted candidates, including skips and their reasons.
4. Replacement forecasts must pass scope, event-family, timing and historical-data checks before final acceptance.

The sampling month is the original catalog-based sampling stratum; it can differ from the event month established during the audit. Replacements can change the original monthly balance.

The screened Economics reserve was exhausted within the study period. This describes the screened pool, not an exhaustive count of every possible eligible market on Polymarket.
